square-single.caption: The sector $0^\circ<\arg(z)<90^\circ,\ |z|<1.5$ (grey) and its image under $F(z)=z^{2}$ (checkerboard), joined by the homotopy $H_t(z)=z^{1+t}$ (principal branch), $0\le t\le 1$. ex-strip-single.caption: The set $\left|\operatorname{Im} z\right| < \frac{\pi}{2}$ and the line $\operatorname{Im}z=0.8$ (grey) and its image under $F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}$ (checkerboard), joined by the homotopies of the steps in turn: for $0\le t\le 1$, the homotopy $H^{(1)}_{t-0}(z)=(e^{tz}-1)/t+t$ for $0<t\le 1$, $H^{(1)}_0(z)=z$ of $f_{1}$; for $1\le t\le 2$, the elliptic M\"obius transformations $H^{(2)}_{t-1}$ that fix $p=i$ and $q=-i$, with $H^{(2)}_{t-1}'(p)=e^{-\pi i t/2}$ of $f_{2}$. Arrows are the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of 4 boundary points and 6 interior points, from $z$ (dot) to $F(z)$. Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of cell $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map. Dashed boundaries do not belong to the sets.
